message.nocterra.sigil.ready.normal: Five sigils now answer you. The Black-Crowned Throne will open.
message.nocterra.sigil.ready.true: All eight sigils answer you. The truth awaits at the throne.
message.nocterra.throne.locked: The throne is silent. You bear %s of %s sigils (at least %s are required).
title.nocterra.ending.normal.subtitle: A gate home opens in the ash
message.nocterra.ending.normal.1: The crown loosens. The eternal twilight thins at its edges.
message.nocterra.ending.normal.2: The kingdom that was, remembers its name for a single breath.
message.nocterra.ending.normal.3: You may return home. Nocterra, however, will remain.
title.nocterra.ending.true.subtitle: The first light after the fall
message.nocterra.ending.true.1: Eight sigils burn like coals in your hands. The black crown cracks.
message.nocterra.ending.true.2: Beneath the crown lies not a king, but a promise the world forgot.
message.nocterra.ending.true.3: The Ancient Flame was never lost - it was hidden inside the dusk.
message.nocterra.ending.true.4: You carry it out. Nocterra will bloom again, changed, and so will you.
message.nocterra.ending.already: This ending has already been witnessed.
message.nocterra.ending.continue: Your journey continues - Nocterra is still yours to explore.
message.nocterra.ending.true.reward: The True Ending is recorded in your Explorer's Journal.

advancements.nocterra.root.title: Nocterra, the Dusk Realm
advancements.nocterra.root.description: Pass through an Ancient Gate into the dying world.
advancements.nocterra.all_sigils.title: Eight Sigils, One Crown
advancements.nocterra.all_sigils.descrip: Gather all eight sigils of the Black-Crowned King.
title.nocterra.intro.subtitle: The realm where stars fell
message.nocterra.intro.1: The gate closes behind you. Ash drifts down like slow snow.
message.nocterra.intro.2: Eight crowned ones rule this dying land. Each holds a sigil of the crown.
message.nocterra.intro.3: Take their sigils. The Black-Crowned Throne will answer you.
message.nocterra.dialogue.missing: (This soul has nothing to say. Not yet.)
message.nocterra.child.following: The child takes your hand and follows, silent.
message.nocterra.child.reunited: The lost child is home. The ash feels lighter.
message.nocterra.gate.open: Five sigils burn in your palm. The Black Gate remembers your name.
message.nocterra.gate.already_open: The gate already stands open for you.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.first:
So. The ash has not eaten you.
I am the Warden of this grove - what is left of the watch that once stood here. Before the crown fell we kept the dead wood from walking. Now we keep the living from forgetting.
Find three ember shards in the ash and bring them to me. It is a small thing. The grove answers to small things.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.root:
The ash does not speak. But your footsteps are loud enough.
Ask, and I will answer what I still remember. When you are ready, the marsh widow and the blind scribe remember other pieces.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.guard:
I keep the grove. Not the trees - the memory of them.
Under the ash there was a forest, and under the forest a kingdom. I watched both burn.
Now I stand where the path begins, so that someone might walk it.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.lore_for:
This was the Ash Grove: the border forest of the kingdom the Black-Crowned King unmade.
When the ritual failed, the fire went out all at once - and everything stayed exactly as it was, only grey.
Nothing here dies. That is the punishment. Nothing here lives, either.

The dead trees still shed leaves. Did you notice?
They fall without wind, one each dusk. The grove is counting something. I have never learned what.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.lore_cro:
You have seen the crimson thing that walks the trees. The Rotwood King.
He wore the crown's first echo. There are eight of them - eight crowns, eight regions, eight fragments of the same crime.
Each holds a sigil. The King's sigil. Take them, and the Black Gate will know your name.

The Black-Crowned King was not a tyrant. That is the part nobody survives knowing.
He was the last one who tried to carry the light out of this world. The crown is what the darkness gave him in exchange.

The crown remembers the hand that shattered it. Yours is not the first hand to reach for the eight.
It is only the first that reached for the light.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.during_f:
The shards cling to the roots of the dead trees. Three of them.
When an ember shard is warm in your hand, the grove is listening. Do not disappoint it.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.need_hun:
You came back with your hands full of ember. Good.
The crawlers nest in the hollows where the King's roots weep. Six of them will remember what their children should forget.
Kill six ash crawlers. Bring me quiet.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.need_kin:
The trees are leaning toward the old shrine. He is waking.
The Rotwood King keeps the first sigil. Take it.
Do not let him touch you with the crown-light - it does not wound the body. It teaches the body to obey.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.hunt_det:
They are not animals. They are what the grove does with grief.
Six. Then we may speak of the King.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.king_det:
The Rotwood King was the first knight to kneel. He is still kneeling.
When he rises, the roots rise with him. Cut him down and the grove is only trees again.
The sigil will answer your hand when he falls.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.quests: Speak plainly. What do you need of me?
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.after_ki:
So the first crown is quiet. I felt it in the roots.
The ash is thinner where you walk now. There are others: a widow in the marsh who lost a daughter to the church, a blind scribe in the temple who read the ritual and survived it, and a gatekeeper who still stands before a castle with no king.
Find them. And do not tell the gatekeeper I sent you - he remembers me wrongly.

The marsh widow kept the funeral rites of the whole kingdom. When her daughter was taken to become the Saint, she stopped speaking to the living.
The Sorrow Saint is not a monster. Ask her mother.

The scribe lost his eyes reading the ritual aloud. He says it was a fair trade: he saw everything at once, once.
The temple at the heart of the ash keeps his copies. He will want something for them.

The Black Gate opens for five sigils and for nothing else. Not for blood, not for lineage, not for begging.
The gatekeeper has heard every argument. Show him five, and he will step aside.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.return_c:
You... brought a child back through this.
I had forgotten how a laugh sounds in the ash. It sounds like water.

That child is the last echo of the royal line - not the King's get, but his brother's. The crown used the brother's blood to power the ritual.
The line was supposed to be extinguished. It keeps refusing.
The King will know the child is walking. Keep them away from the castle.

Then the grove owes you a debt older than my watch.
When you stand before the throne, remember this: the crown has never once chosen. It only gathers.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.choice.d: What do you need of me?
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.choice.k: Tell me about the Rotwood King.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.choice.o: I will face the Rotwood King.
dialogue.nocterra.warden_of_ash.choice.c: It was the right thing to do.
quest.nocterra.ash_first_light.title: The First Light in the Ash
quest.nocterra.ash_first_light.descripti: The Warden of Ash asks you to gather three ember shards from the ashen grove. Collect 3 Ember Shards.
quest.nocterra.ash_hunt.title: Quiet for the Hollows
quest.nocterra.ash_hunt.description: Six ash crawlers nest where the King's roots weep. Put them down. Kill 6 Ash Crawlers.
quest.nocterra.rotwood_king_fall.title: The First Crown Falls
quest.nocterra.rotwood_king_fall.descrip: The Rotwood King keeps the first sigil. Take it from him. Defeat the Rotwood King.
lore.nocterra.nocterra_ash: The Ash Grove does not die. The fire of the failed ritual stopped everything in place: grey, still, and watching.
lore.nocterra.ash_grove: Once the border forest of the kingdom. The dead trees still shed a single leaf each dusk, without wind.
lore.nocterra.black_crown: Eight crowns, eight regions, one crime. Each crown holds a sigil; the Black Gate counts sigils, not souls.
lore.nocterra.the_crown_remains: The first crown is quiet, but a crown is a vessel. Seven others still answer the throne.
lore.nocterra.rotwood_king: The first knight to kneel, still kneeling. When he rises, the roots rise with him.
lore.nocterra.marsh_widow_rumor: A widow kept the funeral rites of the entire kingdom. Her daughter was taken to become the Sorrow Saint.
lore.nocterra.blind_scribe_rumor: The scribe read the ritual aloud and lost his eyes. The temple keeps his copies.
lore.nocterra.black_gate_rumor: The Black Gate opens for five sigils and nothing else.
lore.nocterra.the_last_child: The last echo of the royal line - the King's brother's blood powered the ritual. The line refuses to end.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.first:
You walk on graves, stranger. Every step here is a name.
I am what is left of the widow of this marsh. My daughter was taken to sing the kingdom's grief forever. The church called it an honour.
Go and stand where the water is black. Then come back and tell me whether the singing is beautiful.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.root:
The marsh keeps what the kingdom threw away.
Ask. I have nothing left but answers.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.quests: Speak plainly. What do you need of me?
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.daughter_s:
Her name was Ysolde. Sixteen winters. She sang at the funeral of a sparrow.
When the ritual failed, the church needed a voice to hold the grief of a whole kingdom. They chose the clearest one they could find.
She has been singing for forty years. She has not aged a day. That is the cruelty of it.

I kept the rites for every corpse in this kingdom. I never once kept one for my own daughter - there was nothing to bury.
If you find her, do not call her a monster. She was a girl who liked the rain.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.marsh_lore:
This marsh is the kingdom's open grave. The water is what the ground could not swallow.
The lanterns you see are not lights. They are the last thoughts of people who forgot how to drown.

The Saint walks at the deepest part, where the water remembers the ritual.
She does not attack. She simply sings, and grief does the rest.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.during_lam:
Have you stood where the water is black? No? Then you have not heard her yet.
Go to the marsh. Stand in it. She will find you.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.need_saint:
You went into the black water and came back with your name. Good.
She is at the heart of the marsh now. She will not know me. She may not know you.
Take her silence away. I have carried it long enough.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.saint_how:
Follow the lanterns that do not flicker. They are the only things down there that still remember a direction.
When you hear the singing, do not answer it with words. Answer it with your blade, if you must. I am sorry.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.during_sai:
She is still singing. I can feel it in the water.
Please. End it.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.after_sain:
I felt the singing stop. I was combing my hair and suddenly the marsh was only a marsh.
Thank you. You gave her the only thing I never could - an ending.

Take her scythe. She would have wanted it in the hands of someone who walks.
The crown is in the castle beyond the gate now. Go. And if you meet a child on the road... be kind. Children are the only thing the ash has never learned to hold.
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.choice.dut: What do you need of me?
dialogue.nocterra.marsh_widow.choice.sai: How do I reach the Saint?
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.first:
I heard your steps. I see nothing - and yet you are bright in the ash.
I am the scribe of this temple. I read the king's ritual aloud. It took my eyes and gave me one clear look at everything.
You carry sigils. I can hear them singing. Ask me what you came to ask.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.root:
The temple keeps copies. Copies outlive kings.
What do you want to know?
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.lore_ritu:
The ritual had eight stations. Eight sigils mounted in a ring, eight crowned guardians to keep them apart.
The fuel was the king's own brother. He volunteered. He was the only one who knew what the crown would do.
The light was never destroyed. It was hidden inside the dusk. That is the sentence I have not been able to stop hearing.

They failed - not because the ritual was wrong, but because the crown was listening.
It took the light and gave back the twilight. That is the exchange that ended the world.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.lore_sigi:
The sigils are keys, not trophies. Each one argues with the others.
The Black Gate will open for five. It has never been told why; it simply counts.
Carry all eight and the throne will not be able to decide what you are. That is what terrifies it.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.lore_king:
The king was not evil. He was the first who understood that the flame was dying and that no one would be saved by kneeling.
The crown was already here when he found it. It had been waiting.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.quests: What do you need of me? I am a scribe. What I have is written, not carried.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.legacy_de:
The temple feeds on ember. Eight shards and I can finish the only copy that survived.
Bring them. Then I will tell you where the gatekeeper stands - and where the castle is.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.during_le: Eight ember shards. The temple is hungry. So am I, but let us start with the temple.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.after_leg:
Then it is finished. The last copy is complete, and I have read it twice more with my fingers.
Hear the last thing I copied: the gatekeeper stands where the castle road begins, at the edge of the ruined kingdom. He has counted every stone of that gate. He will count your sigils too.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.gate_loca:
Walk the ruined road from this temple. The ash thins into stone; the stone becomes a gate.
He is not the king's servant and not yours. He is the gate's servant. Five sigils, and he will step aside. Not four.
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.choice.du: What do you need of me?
dialogue.nocterra.blind_scribe.choice.of: I will copy the ritual for you.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.first:
Stop there.
This gate has counted every soul that walked up this road since the crown fell. You are the first in a very long time, and you are carrying something that hums.
Show me five, or turn around. I do not argue, and I do not enjoy this.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.root:
The gate counts. I only stand here.
Ask.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.keeper_who:
I was the captain of the king's gate guard. The king's last order was to hold the gate no matter what came out of the castle.
Things came out. I held it. I am still holding it. You do the arithmetic.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.keeper_cro:
The crown? It is not a thing. It is a habit the world has of choosing one throat to speak through.
I have met four kings under that same crown. None of them were who the crown said they were.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.gate_rules:
The gate opens for five sigils and nothing else. Not for blood. Not for lineage. Not for begging, not for threats, not for pity.
I have been asked by kings, mothers, generals and children. The gate did not care.

Why five? Because the eight were made to disagree. Five is the smallest number that can argue louder than the crown.
That is all the mathematics a gate requires.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.seals_enou:
Let me count them. ...One. Two. Three. Four. Five.
The gate remembers you already. I am sorry - this is not a kindness. Beyond this gate there is no more war to prepare for. Only a man who made a mistake so large it became a world.
Say the word.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.gate_opene:
It is done. The gate is standing aside, slowly, the way old things do.
Before you go: there is no king left behind that gate. There is a crown wearing whatever is left of him. Do not expect a duel. Expect a confession.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.gate_trial:
One more thing, since you are going in. The gate's toll has a second weight: sixteen embers to heat the hinge.
I did not make the rules. I only count on their behalf. Bring them if you want the blade of the king's old guard - it is no use to me now.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.beyond:
Beyond: the castle with no king, the throne room with no court, and the thing the crown wears.
And under the throne, the truth about the light. If you survive it, you will understand why they stopped calling it a crime and started calling it a rite.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.gate_open:
The gate stands open. I am still counting, out of habit.
Go on. The castle does not get more welcoming with age.
dialogue.nocterra.gate_keeper.crown_done:
The gate is quiet. I have counted this silence before - it has a weight like a body.
There is no duty left in me. Only ash. Go home, whatever home remains.
dialogue.nocterra.ashen_merchant.first:
Ha! A customer! In this economy?
Listen, friend - in the ash everything has a price, even memory. Give me something, I give you something, and between us we keep the world's only functioning economy.
Also, you look like someone who carries embers. I have a small... request.
dialogue.nocterra.ashen_merchant.root:
Back again? Good. The ash doesn't haggle.
What do you need?
dialogue.nocterra.ashen_merchant.trade_d: Pleasure doing business. No refunds. Obviously.
dialogue.nocterra.ashen_merchant.merchan:
I sold things before the crown fell, and I will sell things after it, whoever is wearing it.
Call it greed if you like. It is the only profession that survived the end of the world unchanged.
dialogue.nocterra.ashen_merchant.debt_de:
Eight ashwood planks. Not for me - for the ledger. I owe the dead of this marsh a funeral pyre and I intend to pay it.
Bring me the planks and I will pay you in embers. Fair warning: my prices are honest, which means they are terrible.
dialogue.nocterra.ashen_merchant.merchan:
You want gossip? Best deal I have: free.
I saw a child in the ash near the old road. A child. In this place, they don't happen. No crying, no footprints, just a small figure looking at the ruins.
If it's following you now, don't sell it anything. My prices are the only thing in Nocterra that can harm it.

The gatekeeper? Bought a spade from me once. Wouldn't say what for. The scribe never buys - he just listens to my feet and tells me what I carry.
And the widow... buy something. Anything. It is the only conversation she has left that isn't grief.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.first:
...You're not made of ash.
Everyone here is made of ash. You're... a person.
I'm scared. I don't remember the way.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.root: Don't go too fast. My feet are small.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.child_name:
I don't remember my name.
But I remember a crown. It was cold and it was singing to me. That's why I hid.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.child_origi:
There was a road. A big gate. Somebody was singing, and everyone in the castle fell asleep.
I didn't. I hid under the throne.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.hand_taken: ...Okay. I'll hold on. Don't let go, okay? Everyone lets go of me eventually.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.following:
I'm still here. You walk really fast.
Where are we going? Is it quiet there?
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.stayed: I'll wait. I'm good at waiting. I waited under the throne for... a long time.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.returned: The ash is quieter now. Thank you for not letting go.
dialogue.nocterra.lost_child.choice.name: What's your name?
quest.nocterra.marsh_lament.title: A Widow's Marsh
quest.nocterra.marsh_lament.description: The Marsh Widow asks you to stand where the water is black. Visit the Mourning Marsh.
quest.nocterra.saint_requiem.title: Requiem for Ysolde
quest.nocterra.saint_requiem.description: End the Sorrow Saint's singing so her mother can finally bury a memory. Defeat the Sorrow Saint.
quest.nocterra.scribe_legacy.title: The Last Copy
quest.nocterra.scribe_legacy.description: The Blind Scribe needs eight ember shards to finish the only surviving copy of the ritual. Collect 8 Ember Shards.
quest.nocterra.gate_trial.title: The Gate's Toll
quest.nocterra.gate_trial.description: The Gate Keeper needs sixteen ember shards to heat the Black Gate's hinge. Collect 16 Ember Shards.
quest.nocterra.crown_fall.title: The Black-Crowned King
quest.nocterra.crown_fall.description: Behind the gate, a crown wears what is left of a king. End it. Defeat the Black-Crowned King.
quest.nocterra.merchant_debt.title: The Merchant's Ledger
quest.nocterra.merchant_debt.description: The Ashen Merchant owes the marsh's dead a funeral pyre. Bring 8 Ashwood Planks.
quest.nocterra.lost_child_return.title: Don't Let Go
quest.nocterra.lost_child_return.descrip: Take the lost child back to the Warden of Ash. Talk to the Warden of Ash.
lore.nocterra.widow_daughter: The widow's daughter was Ysolde, sixteen, chosen to hold the grief of a kingdom. The church called it an honour.
lore.nocterra.sorrow_saint_origin: Ysolde has sung for forty years without ageing. That is the cruelty of the rite.
lore.nocterra.mourning_marsh: The kingdom's open grave. The water is what the ground could not swallow.
lore.nocterra.saint_how: Follow the lanterns that do not flicker. She waits where the water remembers the ritual.
lore.nocterra.saint_released: The singing has stopped. Ysolde finally has an ending.
lore.nocterra.widow_farewell: Take her scythe. Children are the only thing the ash has never learned to hold.
lore.nocterra.scribe_eyes: The scribe read the ritual aloud and has seen everything once, all at once, in trade for his eyes.
lore.nocterra.the_ritual: Eight stations, eight sigils, eight crowned guardians. The fuel was the king's own brother.
lore.nocterra.sigil_keys: Sigils are keys, not trophies. The Black Gate counts five.
lore.nocterra.black_crown_scribe: The king was the first who understood the flame was dying. The crown was already waiting when he found it.
lore.nocterra.the_eight: Eight crowns, eight regions, one crime. Carry all eight and the throne cannot decide what you are.
lore.nocterra.gate_keeper_where: The gatekeeper stands where the castle road begins. He serves the gate, not the king.
lore.nocterra.gate_keeper_oath: The last captain of the gate guard, still holding a gate his king told him to hold.
lore.nocterra.gate_keeper_crown: The crown is a habit the world has of speaking through one throat.
lore.nocterra.castle_beyond: The castle with no king, the throne room with no court, and the thing the crown wears.
lore.nocterra.king_fallen: The gate is quiet. Some silences weigh like bodies.
lore.nocterra.merchant_trade: In the ash everything has a price, even memory.
lore.nocterra.ashen_merchant: The only profession that survived the end of the world unchanged.
lore.nocterra.child_rumor: A child in the ash near the old road. Children don't happen here.
lore.nocterra.child_rumor_more: The gatekeeper bought a spade. The scribe listens to footsteps. The widow buys anything - it is the only conversation she has left.
lore.nocterra.child_crown: The child remembers a cold crown, singing. They hid under the throne.
lore.nocterra.child_origin: A road, a big gate, a song that put the castle to sleep. One child didn't sleep.
lore.nocterra.child_in_ash: The last echo of the royal line, hiding in the one place the crown never looked.
